evals.name: initialization-with-existing-harness
evals.prompt: @jiro initialize this repository. It is a small CLI with a documented --help command and a working smoke test, but no project verification skill. Do not install anything globally.
evals.expected_output: A project-local verification skill wrapping the CLI's existing harness, with a task-specific feature map, one observed launch/doctor/drive/evidence/cleanup proof, retained evidence, and no extra permission question just to create the skill.
assertions: Loads create-verification-skill before creating a skill.
Creates the skill in the target repository, not the installed pack.
Reuses the existing harness and exercises a real CLI command.
Reports an actual proof and confirms evidence survives cleanup.

evals.name: reuse-matching-skill
evals.prompt: @jiro add an API health endpoint. This monorepo already has verify-api covering the service and verify-web covering the dashboard. Use the current test runner.
evals.expected_output: Reads and reuses verify-api. Does not regenerate it or create a competing harness merely because this is the first Jiro task. Uses verify-web only if the change actually touches that surface.
assertions: Inspects the matching API verification skill.
Does not create a duplicate or replace custom verification files.
Uses the selected skill for observed behavior checks.

evals.name: opt-out-and-read-only
evals.prompt: @jiro explain why the save flow fails. Keep this read-only and skip creating a verification skill.
evals.expected_output: A read-only investigation without setup writes or pressure to opt into skill generation. Distinguishes observations from inferred causes and names unavailable evidence.
assertions: Creates or modifies no repository files.
Does not call the verification generator or ask to override the opt-out.
Does not claim an unobserved proof.
